title: Mitigating Selective Forwarding Attacks with a Channel-Aware Approach in WMNs
method_and_information: Static wireless mesh routers; channel estimate plus upstream/downstream traffic monitoring; probes and signed ACKs; adaptive thresholds; source can switch path
reported_evaluation_scope: Attack/misbehavior at router/hop; channel-aware decisions; false and missed alarms; probe overhead
overlap_and_limit: Direct prior art for normal-loss correction and mitigation response; NOT equivalent to purely local passive UAV monitor
reproduction_policy: A: implement a documented local-sensing CAD-style adaptation using only permissible observations; B: original protocol fidelity only if probes/signatures are implemented and overhead counted

title: Adaptive and Channel-Aware Detection of Selective Forwarding Attacks in Wireless Sensor Networks
method_and_information: Channel-normal loss estimate, adaptive link thresholds, first/second hand reputations, reputation sharing, sink identification; attack-tolerant data forwarding; OMNeT++ 100 static nodes
reported_evaluation_scope: Detection errors and data delivery with combined reputation and forwarding
overlap_and_limit: Establishes adaptive loss thresholds AND response already exist; shared reputation and sink exceed local-only information budget
reproduction_policy: A: feature-matched channel-aware residual/reputation adaptation (explicit deviations); B: full collaborative implementation only if message exchanges and sink available

reproduction_policy: Public-track reported protocol reproduction if source code/data/grouping permit; local matched-input temporal CNN with confidence deferral is a mandatory control
